title: Signal Desktop data
whyItMatters: Signal keeps encrypted conversations, contacts and attachments locally. The folder size shows how much private messaging was retained.
notes: The SQLCipher database and attachments are never opened or decrypted. Unconfirmed (no Mac to test): macOS 27 may protect this folder with com.apple.macl, causing a permission skip.

cleanup.signOut: On the phone that Signal is registered to, open Settings > Linked Devices and remove this Mac, so it stops receiving messages.
steps: Quit Signal on this Mac so its database is not in use.
Move Signal to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the Signal folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: The local message database and attachments are removed from this Mac. The conversations stay on the phone.
